label: TP
reason: User input is sanitized by replacing double quotes with " entities, but the data-name attribute uses single quotes, allowing attackers to inject malicious payloads via unescaped single quotes (e.g., input like "';alert('xss')--" would break out of the attribute and execute JavaScript). The partial escaping does not mitigate all XSS vectors.

evidence.note: User input is partially escaped (double quotes) but remains vulnerable to single-quote-based XSS attacks in the data-name attribute.
